name: gradient-frozen-heat

frames.best_why: Frame 4 is a clean full view with the crimson left edge and sky-blue right edge both visible.

tagline: Crimson rose cools through periwinkle into a clear sky blue.
summary: A static gradient that reads as a heat-to-cold transition: rose-red on the left, periwinkle lavender through the middle, and light sky blue on the right, drawn across a wide rounded block.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle on a black stage. The left edge is a deep rose-crimson, the centre is a soft periwinkle, and the right side opens into a light sky blue, blended on a gentle diagonal.
behaviour: Static: no motion or response; every frame carries the same rose-to-blue sweep.
search_phrases: gradient from red to light blue
vibrant pink to cyan color blend
use_when: A soft warm-to-cool wash should give a page or card a friendly gradient base.
avoid_when: The three stops and the diagonal angle are hardcoded, so a rebrand means editing the file.
customise: className and style change the size or override the gradient; the rose, periwinkle and blue stops sit in the source.
weight_why: A single div with a CSS gradient; nothing runs at runtime.

a11y.note: No interactive parts, so keyboard, focus and labelling are not applicable.

issues: Reported full-bleed footprint conflicts with the rounded inset panel seen in the frames.
polish_why: Smooth blend and even corners; a competent but generic gradient swatch.
